sections.heading: What this procedure does
sections.body: Say which policy rule this procedure carries out.

sections.heading: When it is used
sections.body: Say what triggers it and who starts it.

sections.heading: Steps
sections.body:
List the steps in order, each one an action a person can take.
Name the tool or system used at each step.

sections.heading: Records kept
sections.body: Say what is written down, where, and for how long.

sections.heading: Review
sections.body: Say how often the procedure is tested and updated.
